title: 🐱 Playful & Loving Cats Ready for Adoption in League City - NewsBreak
text:
2 days ago Looking to add a furry friend to your family? These wonderful cats in League City, TX are waiting for someone special to take them home. Each one has their own charm and story — maybe one of them is meant for you!
Ginger Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: 3 months (Baby)
Gender: Female
Color: Gray or Blue
Adoption Fee: $175
Shelter: League City Pets Alive aka FLCAS
Ginger is a confident little explorer who loves to play and cuddle. She’s great with kids, cats, and dogs — a perfect fit for a lively, loving home.
👉 Meet Ginger and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Paprika Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: 3 months (Baby)
Gender: Female
Color: Gray or Blue/White
Adoption Fee: $175
Shelter: League City Pets Alive aka FLCAS
Paprika is a sweet and curious kitten who loves both snuggles and solo adventures. She’s friendly with kids, cats, and dogs — ready to bring warmth and fun to any home.
👉 Meet Paprika and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Koko Breed: Domestic Mediumhair / Domestic Shorthair
Age: Adult
Gender: Female
Color: White/Gray or Blue
Adoption Fee: $75
Shelter: League City Animal Care
Phone: (281) 554-1377
Koko is a lovely adult cat with a soft coat and gentle nature. She’s looking for a calm, caring home where she can relax and be loved.
👉 Meet Koko and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Talon (Yellow collar) Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Baby
Gender: Male
Color: Black (All)
Adoption Fee: $75
Shelter: League City Animal Care
Phone: (281) 554-1377
Talon is a playful black kitten full of curiosity and energy. He’s ready to grow up in a home filled with love and attention.
👉 Meet Talon and apply to adopt on adoptapet
